project_name.justification: The text explicitly names the project: "The Firesteel project ('Firesteel' or the 'Project' or 'Property'), previously referred to as the Honeyjack project..."

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified at the beginning of the article: "International Lithium Corp. (TSXV: ILC) (OTCQB: ILHMF) (FSE: IAH) (the 'Company' or 'ILC') is pleased to announce that it has completed the purchase..."

ceo_buyer.justification: The CEO of the buyer is identified in a quote: "John Wisbey, Chairman and CEO of ILC, commented:"

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The article states the interest acquired: "...completed the purchase of a 90% interest in a highly prospective grass roots copper and cobalt property..."

primary_commodity.justification: The CEO's comment clarifies the primary commodity: "Firesteel is primarily a copper project."

verified_article_link.justification: The article is titled "International Lithium Completes Purchase of the Highly Prospective Firesteel Copper Project Near Upsala, Ontario...", which directly pertains to the project of interest.

currency.justification: The currency is specified in the payment terms: "Paying on the Effective Date CAD $55,000 to the Vendor (paid);"

cash_payments_raw.justification: The total cash payment is the sum of initial payments ($55,000 + $110,000) and two future milestone payments of $1,000,000 each. "Paying on the Effective Date CAD $55,000 to the Vendor (paid); Within 15 calendar days paying CAD $110,000 to the Vendor (paid); and Granting the right to receive the following milestone payments: if ILC establishes a Resource Calculation... ILC shall pay to the Vendor CAD $1,000,000... if ILC establishes a Resource Calculation... ILC shall pay to the Vendor a further CAD $1,000,000"

share_payments_raw.justification: The article explicitly states that the provision to issue shares was withdrawn: "...the original application to TSX Venture Exchange that also carried a provision for the Company to issue shares at its option as payment for the above Resource Bonus Thresholds has been withdrawn."

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The deal consideration is broken down into explicit cash payments, so this combined field is not applicable.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The provision to issue shares was withdrawn, so no shares were issued as part of the transaction. "...the original application to TSX Venture Exchange that also carried a provision for the Company to issue shares at its option as payment for the above Resource Bonus Thresholds has been withdrawn."

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: The transaction terms described in the article do not mention any share warrants.

option_payments_raw.justification: The transaction terms described in the article do not mention any option payments.

issued_share_price.justification: No shares were issued as part of the transaction, so there is no issue price.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The company announced its drilling plans for the project: "The Company intends to test up to six distinct targets with up to 2,000 metres of core drilling."

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The exploration commitment is stated in meters of drilling, not as a monetary value.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The transaction terms for the Firesteel project do not mention any Net Smelter Royalty (NSR) or Gross Revenue Royalty (GRR).

coverage_area_raw.justification: The project area is specified multiple times: "316 mining claim units covering an area of approximately 6,600 hectares;" and in a table: "Firesteel | Cu | Ontario | 6,600 | Exploration"

coverage_area_unit.justification: The unit for the coverage area is explicitly stated: "316 mining claim units covering an area of approximately 6,600 hectares;"

resource_size.justification: The text indicates that a resource has not yet been established; it is a future target for milestone payments. "if ILC establishes a Resource Calculation equal to or exceeding 10,000,000 metric tonnes at 1% Copper (the 'First Resource Bonus Threshold'), ILC shall pay to the Vendor CAD $1,000,000"

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer's ticker and exchange are provided in the first paragraph: "International Lithium Corp. (TSXV: ILC)"
